framework.name: Illinois Learning Standards for Social Science, Grades 6-8
framework.note: Codes are the Illinois Learning Standards for Social Science for grades 6-8 (inquiry, civics, economics, geography and history); the suffixes LC, MdC and MC mark less, moderately and more complex expectations. The alignment was made by the course author and is not a certification by any agency.
